claim-chorus-submit-gate.statement: The zsh init and the chorus-pi-daemon script export CHORUS_SUBMIT_GATE=block next to CHORUS_URL.
claim-chorus-submit-gate.falsifier: Either the evaluated programs.zsh.initContent or the built chorus-pi-daemon script lacks export CHORUS_SUBMIT_GATE=block.

claim-context-mode-single.statement: M-02877 declares no context-mode MCP server, and the piMcpServers activation deletes a context-mode entry from mcp.json.
claim-context-mode-single.falsifier: nix eval of piAgent.mcpServers contains context-mode, or the piMcpServers jq filter keeps a context-mode key.

claim-deploy-freshness.statement: just deploy-darwin runs scripts/deploy-freshness.sh first, and that script exits 1 when HEAD does not contain origin/main unless DEN_DEPLOY_STALE is set.
claim-deploy-freshness.falsifier: The script exits 0 at a commit that lacks origin/main without DEN_DEPLOY_STALE, or the Justfile recipe does not call it first.

claim-pi-research-exclusion.statement: On M-02877, piAgent.skills holds -/Users/dktaohan/.agents/skills/research, so pi resolves skill:research to the chorus-pi package.
claim-pi-research-exclusion.falsifier: nix eval of home-manager.users.dktaohan.piAgent.skills lacks the entry, or pi --mode rpc get_commands resolves skill:research to ~/.agents/skills.

claim-pins-latest.statement: ponytail is pinned at 5.3.3 and the personal Signet container image at ghcr.io/signet-ai/signet:0.238.0.
claim-pins-latest.falsifier: nix eval of piAgent.packages lacks npm:@dietrichgebert/ponytail@5.3.3, or the signet-container ProgramArguments lack signet:0.238.0.

claim-signet-pi-mode.statement: Each switch on M-02877 runs chmod 600 on ~/.pi/agent/extensions/signet-pi.js when the file exists.
claim-signet-pi-mode.falsifier: The evaluated home.activation.signetPiExtensionMode lacks the chmod 600, or the entry is missing.
